notes.title: Vote for a Infinitum!
notes.notes:
Vote for a new game!
Infinitum Now the Greenlight!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=781504531
First of all "Infinitum" - this is a game about space, about the love for him, in which you can freely surf the cosmic space, as well as to visit the planet and space stations.
But also it is also a mission, in which you need to find five pieces of an ancient artifact, because the universe is in danger.
For the most part the game relaxing. However, we must not forget about the oxygen level as on your spaceship and in your suit if you decide to visit a planet with an atmosphere unfit for respiration (and there will be a majority). You should always maintain the charged life-support system, and a full tank of fuel, because when it is over, you are not able to fly anywhere.
And, of course, need to be prepared to meet with extraterrestrial beings, because they may be hostile, or they may be robots, left there guard is just what you need ....
At the moment, the game is on alpha stage, there is still a long way ....

notes.title: Vote for new game! Invisible Mind now live on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
Go on a trip around the worlds created by your own mind and learn yourself.
Invisible Mind is a surreal philosophical quest, a puzzle, in which players will not just look for "clues", solve puzzles, but also pass the real tests in which they will be able to learn more about themselves. In the story, the consciousness of the protagonist was extracted from frozen brain in a special environment "Vacuumnet" and the leaders of the company "Complex" who run out "the removing", try to retrieve memories about the past life of the patient, who wanders through the worlds generated by their own minds.


Who you are? Introvert or extrovert? Choleric or phlegmatic? By what percentage you're a robot? Or a schizophrenic?
Find out the answers in this game.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=717586093

notes.title: Mega collection of IndiGala, as well as a new set of VGstudio
notes.notes:
I am glad to inform you, my friends, that the game Project Pulsation and Z.I.O.N., came in a chic collection of Italian partners  Indie Gala, which is available here https://www.indiegala.com/indielife#, while saving up to 95%.
It is also good news in the fact that it is now available sets of games from VGhstudio such as Deluxe Edition, which includes the game + soundtrack (save 20%), and the Gold Edition, which includes two games + DLC them (save 50%) .
Thanks to those who are with us!

notes.title: Project Pulsation Soundtracks has been released on Steam!

Project Pulsation Soundtracks has been released!
Eerie and enveloping music from the game Project Pulsation, in the style of ambient, dark ambient, written by V.G., and tough and aggressive music from the trailers for the game, in the style of breakbeat, electro punk, drum and bass, written by Devil Dragon Tattoo.
Total 13 tracks in mp3 320 kbps now  now available on Steam.

Thanks to your feedbacks we have implemented a bunch of fixes & improvements: 
[list]
[*][b]STEAM TRADING CARDS ADDED![/b]
[*]Slo-mo hints added 
[*]Improved ligthing on first two levels 
[*]Flashlight improved 
[*]Fall-through-floor bugs fixed 
[*]Oxygen and Checkpoints are now highlighted 
[*]Small bugfixes 
[/list]

Thank you and enjoy your stay at 'Complex'.
